'''Hance Rugel''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the Special Aide to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He handled the Chancellor's communications.<ref name="Day of Dread" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hance Rugel appears in hologram form in "Day of Dread," the introductory mission for the Daily Area of [[Oricon]] that was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.4.<ref name="Day of Dread" />
